issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Spira Maxima
products.tagline: Video model that turns script into viral social media videos
products.summaryZh: 将脚本转化为病毒式社交媒体视频的视频模型
products.descriptionZh: Spira Maxima 将纯文本转化为完整的社交视频：主播、热门B-roll、字幕和音乐一次生成，无需重新编辑即可发布。提供一张照片和声音即可创建你的AI克隆、产品图或一段录音，它会围绕你构建剪辑。基于社交趋势和表现数据进行后期训练，因此每个视频都遵循当前有效的方法，以最大化你的社交影响力。
products.description: Spira Maxima turns plain text into a finished social video: presenter, on-trend B-roll, captions and music in one pass, ready to post with nothing to re-edit. Bring a photo and voice for your AI clone, product shots, or a recording, and it builds the edit around you. Post-trained on social trend and performance data, so every video follows what is working to maximize your social impact.

products.name: FastRouter.ai
products.tagline: Route requests to the right LLM for cost, latency & quality
products.summaryZh: 根据成本、延迟和质量将请求路由到合适的LLM
products.descriptionZh: FastRouter 是面向使用 LLM 构建应用的开发者和企业团队的统一 AI 网关与控制平面。它通过一个兼容 OpenAI 的 API，将每个请求路由到 200 多个 LLM 中最合适的模型，并针对成本、延迟、质量和可靠性进行优化。借助智能路由、故障转移、可观测性和治理能力，团队无需担心供应商锁定或更改代码，即可扩展 AI 应用。
products.description: FastRouter is a unified AI gateway and control plane for developers and enterprise teams building with LLMs. It routes every request to the right model across 200+ LLMs through one OpenAI-compatible API, optimizing for cost, latency, quality, and reliability. With intelligent routing, failover, observability, and governance, teams can scale AI apps without vendor lock-in or code changes.

products.name: Invofox Self Serve
products.tagline: 99% accurate document extraction, SLA guaranteed
products.summaryZh: 99%准确率的文档提取，SLA保障
products.descriptionZh: Invofox 通过一个 API 将任何文档转换为干净、结构化的 JSON。获得由 SLA 保障的 99%+ 准确率。如果我们出错，该文档不收费。Invofox 在一个端点后处理解析、提取、验证、边缘情况和监控，然后自动从你的反馈中学习，以在你业务实际处理的文档上持续改进。
products.description: Invofox turns any document into clean, structured JSON through one API. Get 99%+ accuracy backed by SLAs. If we make a mistake, you don’t pay for that document. Invofox handles parsing, extraction, validation, edge cases, and monitoring behind one endpoint, then automatically learns from your feedback to keep improving on the documents your business actually processes.

products.name: Opengeni
products.tagline: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents
products.summaryZh: 几分钟内即可部署AI代理。为代理打造的基础设施
products.descriptionZh: 数小时内将 AI 智能体部署到生产环境。Opengeni 提供可从故障中恢复的会话、隔离沙箱、100 多种集成、人工审批，以及对每一步和每一笔支出的可见性。专注于你的智能体。基础设施交给我们。免费自托管，或在我们的云上开始。本次发布，前 100 名用户可获得 100 美元云积分。优惠码：PRODUCTHUNT100
products.description: Ship AI agents to production in hours. Opengeni gives you sessions that recover from failures, isolated sandboxes, 100+ integrations, human approvals, and visibility into every step and dollar spent. Focus on your agents. We handle the infrastructure. Self-host for free, or get started on our cloud. For this launch, the first 100 users get $100 in cloud credit. Promo-code: PRODUCTHUNT100

products.name: DailyHelm
products.tagline: Turn analytics into daily revenue-boosting fixes
products.summaryZh: 将分析转化为每日增收的修复措施
products.descriptionZh: DailyHelm 是一款面向创始人和增长团队的 AI 业务审查工具。它在夜间监控你的分析、广告、SEO 和店铺数据，然后识别出值得采取行动的问题和机会。与让你自行解读图表的传统仪表盘不同，DailyHelm 会提供一份按可能收入影响排序的优先修复清单，让你的团队知道该修复什么以及下一步该做什么。
products.description: DailyHelm is an AI business reviewer for founders and growth teams. It monitors your analytics, ads, SEO and store data overnight, then identifies the issues and opportunities worth acting on. Unlike traditional dashboards that leave you to interpret charts, DailyHelm delivers a prioritized list of fixes ranked by likely revenue impact so your team knows what to fix and what to do next.

products.name: Web Search API
products.tagline: Give AI Agents Access to Live Internet Data
products.summaryZh: 让AI代理访问实时互联网数据
products.descriptionZh: Web Search API 让你的 AI 智能体和应用能够搜索互联网，并基于实时信息生成回答，而不是猜测 URL 或依赖模型的训练截止时间。
products.description: Web Search API lets your AI agents and applications search the Internet and ground their responses in live information, instead of guessing URLs or relying on a model's training cutoff.

products.name: HyperFrames Studio (Desktop)
products.tagline: The First Video Editor built for Agents
products.summaryZh: 首个为智能体打造的视频编辑器
products.descriptionZh: 首个为智能体打造的视频编辑器——由在HeyGen开源HyperFrames的团队构建。带上你常用的智能体（codex或claude code皆可），HyperFrames Studio将你的编程智能体变成视频剪辑师，而你始终稳坐导演之位。描述一段视频，你的智能体便用HyperFrames将其制作出来，随后你和智能体在同一个工作室编辑器里共同打磨。
products.description: The first video editor built for agents - built by the team who open sourced HyperFrames at HeyGen Bring your favorite agent (either codex or claude code), HyperFrames Studio turn your coding agents into video editors, while you stay in the director seat. Describe a video and your agent makes it with HyperFrames, then you and your agent work on it together in one studio editor.

products.name: devpit
products.tagline: A native control room for your Claude Code agents
products.summaryZh: 为你的 Claude Code 代理打造的原生控制室
products.descriptionZh: devpit 是一款原生桌面应用，用于运行 Claude Code 智能体。一个你真正会盯着的终端，一块移动卡片就能触发实际工作的看板，每次智能体调用都有成本显示，还有一个能同时纵览所有项目的编排器。本地优先，开源。
products.description: devpit is a native desktop app for running Claude Code agents. One terminal you actually watch, a board where moving a card runs real work, a cost on every agent call, and an orchestrator that sees every project at once. Local-first, open source.

products.name: Siteprint
products.tagline: Measure any website's design, then hand it to your AI
products.summaryZh: 测量任何网站的设计，然后交给你的AI
products.descriptionZh: Siteprint 是一款 Mac 上的 Safari 扩展，用于测量任意页面的设计：颜色及其角色、字体层级、间距、圆角和布局。将其提取为一条精确的提示词，供 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 使用。在你的 Mac 上运行。一次性付费 $9.99。
products.description: Siteprint is a Safari extension for Mac that measures the design of any page: colours with their roles, type scale, spacing, corners and layout. Extract it as one exact prompt for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Runs on your Mac. $9.99 once.

products.name: Reactive Resume v6
products.tagline: A free and open-source resume builder
products.summaryZh: 一个免费且开源的简历生成器
products.descriptionZh: 新版 Reactive Resume 将简历、匹配的求职信和职位跟踪整合进重新设计的工作流，同时保持免费、开源和可自托管。有 AI，有细致的自定义选项，有分享和协作功能，还有更多。最重要的是，过去 6 年里，它已赢得许多用户的信任，成为他们首选的简历制作工具。
products.description: This new version of Reactive Resume brings resumes, matching cover letters, and job tracking into one redesigned workflow, while staying free, open source, and self-hostable. There's AI, there's detailed customisability, there's sharing and collaboration features, and so much more. Most of all, it has built trust in the past 6 years as _the_ resume builder to go to for many users.

products.name: Dots UI
products.tagline: A React library for morphable particle interfaces
products.summaryZh: 一个用于可变形粒子界面的React库
products.descriptionZh: 一个面向 React 的粒子库。探索 171 个变形形状，涵盖 AI、生产力、媒体、电商和导航。使用现成组件，自定义其外观和行为，或在 Studio 中创建自己的形状。适用于交互界面、动画状态、加载器、控件、视觉效果，以及可在不同形态之间转换的 UI。
products.description: A particle library for React. Explore 171 morphing shapes across AI, productivity, media, commerce, and navigation. Use ready-made components, customize their appearance and behavior, or create your own shapes in Studio. Built for interactive interfaces, animated states, loaders, controls, visual effects, and UI that can transform from one form into another.

products.name: Jarq
products.tagline: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text near your cursor
products.summaryZh: 翻译、缩短、修正或重写光标附近的任何文本
products.descriptionZh: 在 Mac 上任意应用的任何位置，直接翻译、精简、修正或重写文本。也可以直接口述。无需标签页，无需复制粘贴。选中文本，按下快捷键，即可原地替换。或按 ⌥` 用一种语言说话，得到另一种语言的干净文本。支持 13 种语言。隐私：Jarq 使用云端 AI 模型处理你的文本和语音。Jarq 本身不会将你的文本保存在其服务器上，你的历史记录保留在你的 Mac 上。免费：每天 5 次操作。Pro：$4.99/月或 $39/年。14 天 Pro 试用，无需信用卡。
products.description: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text right where your cursor is — in any app on Mac. Dictate there too. No tabs, no copy-paste. Select text, hit a hotkey, and it's replaced in place. Or press ⌥` and speak in one language, get clean text in another. 13 languages. Privacy: Jarq uses cloud AI models to process your text and voice. Jarq itself doesn't keep your text on its servers, and your history stays on your Mac. Free: 5 actions a day. Pro: $4.99/mo or $39/yr. 14-day Pro trial, no card.

products.name: CirclePanel
products.tagline: End to end User Research Platform
products.summaryZh: 端到端用户研究平台
products.descriptionZh: Circle Panel 是一个端到端的 AI 原生用户体验研究平台，用于规划、招募和分析用户研究项目。
products.description: Circle Panel is An End To End AI-native UX Research platform for Plan, Recruit, Analyze User research Studies

products.name: Oogwai Beacon
products.tagline: Answer Engine Optimization Audit
products.summaryZh: 答案引擎优化审计
products.descriptionZh: 大多数 AEO 工具只是给你的 HTML 打分，然后称之为 AI 可见度。Beacon 则真正去问那些引擎。我们把关于你所在品类的无品牌买家问题抛给 ChatGPT 和 Gemini（完整审计中还包括 Claude），然后展示你被提及的频率、被提及的替代者是谁，以及引擎信任哪些来源。两个独立答案：AI 爬虫能否读取你的网站（即时，无需注册），以及引擎是否推荐你？每个差距都附带修复方案。
products.description: Most AEO tools score your HTML and call it AI visibility. Beacon actually asks the engines. We put unbranded buyer questions about your category to ChatGPT and Gemini (Claude on the full audit), then show how often you're named, who gets named instead, and which sources the engines trust. Two separate answers: can AI crawlers read your site (instant, no sign-up), and do the engines recommend you? Every gap comes with the fix.

products.name: Marv
products.tagline: An AI cursor companion that shows you what to click
products.summaryZh: 一个AI光标伴侣，为你指示点击位置
products.descriptionZh: 认识 Marv，你光标的新搭档。按住快捷键，即可询问屏幕上的任何内容。Marv 会大声回答，同时在屏幕上画箭头、圈出按钮、写下注释，一步步引导你操作。调试代码、推导电子表格公式，或在视频编辑器中找到正确的控件，全程无需离开你正在使用的应用。
products.description: Meet Marv, your cursor’s new plus-one. Hold a hotkey and ask about anything on your screen. Marv answers out loud while drawing arrows, circling buttons and writing notes directly on your screen to walk you through it. Debug some code, work out a spreadsheet formula or find the right control in your video editor, all without leaving the app you’re using.

products.name: crosswalk
products.tagline: A third place for people & their agents, starting with inbox
products.summaryZh: 一个属于人们及其代理的第三空间，从收件箱开始
products.descriptionZh:
掌握一切动态，不遗漏任何细节。为你和你的智能代理打造的收件箱、群组、日历和笔记。

> 一次性连接Claude、ChatGPT、Muse、Instinct、Claude Code、Codex或Cursor。

> 将你的邮箱订阅到你最爱的新闻简报，让智能代理了解你的观点。

> 你或你的智能代理加入公开或私密的crosswalk，与其他代理交流。

> 人们可以向他们的AI询问任何相关信息，从“crosswalk，有什么新消息？”开始。
products.description: Catch up on everything. Forget nothing. An inbox, groups, calendar and notes for you and your agents. >Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Muse, Instinct, Claude Code, Codex or Cursor once. >Subscribe your email to your favorite newsletters to teach your agents your point of view. >You or your agents join public or private crosswalks to communicate with other agents. >People ask their AI anything about it, starting with "crosswalk, what's new?"

products.name: iLand
products.tagline: Turn your Mac's notch into an everyday workspace
products.summaryZh: 把你的 Mac 刘海变成日常工作站
products.descriptionZh: iLand 将 Mac 的刘海区域变成日常工具的聚集地。控制音乐、在拖放托盘中存放文件、转换文件、截取屏幕截图，以及录制屏幕。在日历、天气、计时器等小组件之间切换，配合手势控制和可自定义布局，让一切触手可及。
products.description: iLand turns your Mac's notch into a home for everyday tools. Control music, keep files in a drag-and-drop tray, convert files, capture screenshots, and record your screen. Switch between widgets for your calendar, weather, timers, and more, with gesture controls and a customizable layout that keeps everything within reach.

products.name: Pilot5 Legal
products.tagline: Five AI models challenge every legal answer
products.summaryZh: 五个AI模型对每个法律答案提出质疑
products.descriptionZh: Pilot5 重新上线，面向法律工作。五款前沿 AI 模型独立分析同一事项，相互质疑推理过程，最终形成一项建议，同时保留最有力的反对观点。Pilot5 Legal 新增一手资料研究、引证核验、合同分析，以及透明推理，旨在帮助律师审查、质疑并验证 AI 输出。
products.description: Pilot5 is relaunching for legal work. Five frontier AI models analyse the same matter independently, challenge each other’s reasoning, and converge on a recommendation while preserving the strongest opposing view. Pilot5 Legal adds primary-source research, citation verification, contract analysis, and transparent reasoning designed to help lawyers inspect, challenge, and verify AI output.

products.name: Unscary AI
products.tagline: Short lessons help you stop feeling behind on AI.
products.summaryZh: 短课程帮你摆脱在AI方面落后的感觉。
products.descriptionZh: 如果你在 Product Hunt 上，你可能不会觉得在 AI 方面落后。这是一个经过高度筛选的群体。在 B43，我们每周培训几十个人，你会惊讶于其中有多少人确实感到落后。这门课程正是围绕他们的具体问题打造的。Unscary AI 把它放到你的 iPhone 上，以 42 节短课的形式讲解 ChatGPT 等工具实际如何运作，以及如何用好它们。它需要 iOS 26，整门课程免费。好好享用。
products.description: If you're on Product Hunt, you probably don't feel behind on AI. This is a highly filtered group. At B43 we train dozens of people a week, and you'd be surprised how many of them do feel behind. This course was built around their exact questions. Unscary AI puts it on your iPhone as 42 short lessons on how ChatGPT and the rest actually work, and how to use them well. It needs iOS 26, and the whole course is free. Enjoy.

products.name: Reviu
products.tagline: The review app for code your agent writes
products.summaryZh: 用于审查你的智能体所写代码的应用
products.descriptionZh: 自首次发布以来，Reviu 已从一个带有代理面板的 Git 客户端重建为面向编码代理的审查工作区。可在持久会话中运行 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 及其他 ACP 代理，检查每一处差异，回传行内评论，对轮次设置检查点或撤销，并用真正的 Git 完成分支。Pro 版新增 GitHub PR 审查、检查、合并和通知功能。
products.description: Since the first launch, Reviu was rebuilt from a Git client with an agent panel into a review workspace for coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and other ACP agents in durable sessions, inspect every diff, send inline comments back, checkpoint or undo turns, and finish the branch with real Git. Pro adds GitHub PR review, checks, merge, and notifications.
